mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals persistent monetary accommodation that reduces equity discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% for two consecutive months indicates severe labor market deterioration that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for UNRATE > 9.0% for 2 months is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of joint decline instances, or Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary regimes (GDPC1 growth < -1.0% YoY), industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 90.0 indicates deepening economic contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO decline instances during recession, or Rank IC for the signal in recession is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals sustained consumer spending strength that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 12-month MA, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that prompt imminent Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) from prior month indicate labor force withdrawal due to discouraged workers, weakening consumer demand and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of joint decline instances, or Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases (GDPC1 growth > 1.0% YoY), housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 600.0 thousand units signals strengthening consumer confidence that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved economic outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of HOUST > 600.0 instances during recovery, or Rank IC for the signal in recovery is below 0.03.
